name: Fluent Forms
notes: Stops the weekly email summary of form entries, does not store the visitor's IP address with each entry, and removes the Fluent Forms menu from the admin bar. Form view counting stays off, as it is by default.

_fluentform_global_form_settings.misc.is.label: Disable IP Logging
_fluentform_global_form_settings.misc.is.description: If this option is turned on, the user’s IP address will not be saved with the form data.

_fluentform_global_form_settings.misc.ad.label: Admin Top Navigation
_fluentform_global_form_settings.misc.ad.description: The Fluent Forms menu in the admin bar.

_fluentform_email_report_summary.status.label: Enable Email Summaries
_fluentform_email_report_summary.status.description: A weekly email on how your forms are performing.
